title_original: ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’ NYC Premiere Red Carpet Photos: Jennifer Lawrence, Mckenna Grace, Rachel Zegler & More
excerpt_original: New York City welcomed the stars of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping for the film’s premiere. The stars of the Francis Lawrence-directed film have been on a world tour promoting the prequel, stopping in Sydney (Australia), Paris (France), London (England), Berlin…

blocks.text: New York City welcomed the stars of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping for the film’s premiere.

links.text: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping

blocks.text: The stars of the Francis Lawrence-directed film have been on a world tour promoting the prequel, stopping in Sydney (Australia), Paris (France), London (England), Berlin (Germany), Madrid (Spain), Mexico City (Mexico), and Los Angeles (USA).
Written by Billy Ray and Michael Lesslie and based on Suzanne Collins’s book, the film is set to open in theaters on November 20.
The red carpet saw Mckenna Grace, Joseph Zada, and Whitney Peak reunite with stars from Hunger Games past, like Rachel Zegler, Tom Blyth, and Katniss Everdeen—Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson.

links.text: All The Times Mckenna Grace Channeled Jennifer Lawrence & ‘Hunger Games’ Past During ‘Sunrise On The Reaping’ Press Tour

blocks.text: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping follows sixteen-year-old Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) from District 12, beginning on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Annual Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell, the biggest Games yet with twice as many tributes.

Set in the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games , the story follows Haymitch into the arena, where he forms an unlikely alliance with fellow tribute Maysilee Donner (Mckenna Grace) and joins a coalition determined to challenge the Capitol’s control under President Snow (Ralph Fiennes).
As the competition unfolds, Haymitch risks everything to take down the Games from within the arena — setting in motion the rebellion that will change Panem forever.

links.text: ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’ Red Carpet Photos: All Of Joseph Zada & Mckenna Grace’s Looks From Press Tour

blocks.text: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping stars Joseph Zada (Haymitch), Mckenna Grace (Maysilee), Glenn Close (Drusilla), Ralph Finneas (President Snow), Billy Porter (Magno), Maya Hawke (Wiress), Elle Fanning (Effie), Percy Daggs IV (Ampert), Whitney Peak (Lenore Dove), Lili Taylor (Mags), Kiran Culkin (Caesar Flickerman), Kelvin Harrison Jr (Beetee), Jesse Plemons (Plutarch), Ben Wang (Wyatt), among others.

Some of the celebrities in the Big Apple included the cast of Disney+’s Percy Jackson (Walker Scobell, Leah Jeffries and Charlie Bushnell), Leslie Mann, Judd Apatow, Busy Philipps, SNL ‘s Jane Wickline, Ralph Macchio, among others. Bravo stars also made an appearance, like Southern Charm’s Madison LeCroy, Next Gen NYC’s Gia Giudice, and Real Housewives of New York City’s Erin Lichy.
